neighbours.label: a verb or limiter saying a remedy treats only part of a problem (only kill the ants you see, only treat the symptoms)
fire: Most home flea sprays only kill the fleas you can see.
These creams only treat the symptoms, not the infection.
Cheap weed killers only burn the leaves above the ground.
Many diets only reduce the weight you put on last month.
That patch only fixes the bug you happened to report.
Short courses only cover the basics of the whole subject.
Most mouse traps only catch the mice that run past them.
Pain pills only mask the problem and leave the cause.
quiet: Most home flea sprays smell like lemon and come in blue cans.
These creams come in tubes and cost about five dollars.
Cheap weed killers are sold in the aisle near the tools.
Many diets begin on a Monday with a list of foods.
That patch was written by a student at the local college.
Short courses are held in the spring at the town hall.
Most mouse traps are made of wood and thin wire.
Pain pills are kept on the top shelf at home.
